# Protocodus

> Protocodus s.r.o. is an independent software and audio engineering studio based in Prague, Czech Republic, founded by Vojtěch Hordějčuk on March 5, 2026. Protocodus develops Riffle (a desktop music workstation, available soon), Reason Rack Extensions (physically modelled acoustic instruments, circuit-modelled synthesizers, and audio effects for the Reason Studios Rack), command-line audio tools, and ad-free browser games.

## Flagship Software

- [Riffle — Desktop Music Workstation](https://protocodus.cz/product/riffle/): Native DAW for macOS, Linux, and Windows, available soon. Audio and MIDI recording, take comping, piano roll, non-destructive audio editing, three built-in R1 instruments (`R1 Mini`, `R1 Sampler`, `R1 Drums`) and seven R1 effects (`R1 Filter`, `R1 Equalizer`, `R1 Saturator`, `R1 Compressor`, `R1 Modulator`, `R1 Spacer`, `R1 Strip`), isolated VST3, CLAP, LV2 (Linux) and Audio Unit (macOS) plug-ins, buses/sends/sidechains, automation, reversible Freeze, self-contained projects, and optional scoped OpenAI/Anthropic or MCP AI assistance.

## Acoustic & Modelled Instruments (Newest First)

- [Oregana — Modelled Church Organ](https://protocodus.cz/product/oregana/): Physically modelled 51-stop church organ Rack Extension across three manuals and pedal (Shop release `0.12.3`, 2026-11-24; latest build `0.14.0f1`, 2026-11-27) with shared winding, sagging bellows, variable church acoustics, 77 patches, and a [playable browser edition](https://protocodus.cz/fun/oregana/). [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/oregana-church-organ/)
- [Respira — Modelled Accordion](https://protocodus.cz/product/respira/): Physically modelled bellows accordion Rack Extension (Shop release `0.1.27`, 2026-11-18; latest build `0.10.0f1`, 2026-11-27) with eight registers, Stradella bass, auto/manual mod-wheel bellows, and four physically distinct accordion types in the development build. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/respira-bellows-accordion/)
- [Keyra — Modelled Grand Piano](https://protocodus.cz/product/keyra/): Physically modelled piano Rack Extension (Shop release `2.24.0`, 2026-11-24; latest build `2.24.4f1`, 2026-11-20) featuring four grands and an upright, five calibrated microphones, three pedals, sympathetic resonance, 13 patches, and a [playable browser edition](https://protocodus.cz/fun/keyra/). [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/keyra-modelled-grand-piano/)
- [Electry — Modelled Electric Guitar](https://protocodus.cz/product/electry/): Physically modelled six-string electric guitar Rack Extension (in development, latest build `2.11.2d1`, 2026-11-25) with a Strat and a Telecaster, measured single-coil pickups, floating tremolo bridge, a keyswitch deck on every piano key, and string-solo keys.
- [Acukoto — Modelled Koto](https://protocodus.cz/product/acukoto/): Physically modelled 13-string paulownia koto Rack Extension (Shop release `0.25.23`, device `0.25.23f2`, first released 2026-11-12; the same build is the latest on Rack main) with movable bridges, Hirajoshi/Chromatic tunings, left-hand bends, and mic/piezo outs. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/acukoto-modelled-koto/)
- [Aculele — Modelled Ukulele](https://protocodus.cz/product/aculele/): Physically modelled ukulele Rack Extension (Shop release `0.4.70`, device `0.4.70f6`, first released 2026-11-17; the same build is the latest on Rack main) with soprano, concert, and tenor bodies, nylon/fluorocarbon strings, chord strumming, and mic/piezo outs. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/aculele-modelled-ukulele/)
- [Aculyre — Modelled Lyre](https://protocodus.cz/product/aculyre/): Physically modelled lyre harp Rack Extension (Shop release `0.13.5`, 2026-11-17; latest build `0.13.17f1`, 2026-11-24) with Concert, Classical, and Nordic models, gut/nylon/steel strings, sympathetic resonance, and mic/piezo outs. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/aculyre-modelled-lyre/)
- [Acustra — Acoustic Guitar](https://protocodus.cz/product/acustra/): Physically modelled six-string steel-string acoustic guitar Rack Extension (Shop release `1.9.41`, first released 2026-10-20; latest build `1.9.65f1`, 2026-11-25 / source `1.9.69f1`, 2026-11-27) with four body shapes, fingerpicking/strumming, and mic/piezo capture. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/acustra-acoustic-guitar/)
- [Maremba — Marimba, Balafon & Kalimba](https://protocodus.cz/product/maremba/): Physically modelled mallet and tine percussion Rack Extension (Shop release `1.6.5`, device `1.6.5f4`, first released 2026-10-13; the same build is the latest on Rack main) modelling two marimbas, balafon, and kalimba with seven outputs and 20 patches. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/maremba/)

## Synthesizers (Newest First)

- [Trancera — Virtual Analog Synth](https://protocodus.cz/product/trancera/): Eight-voice virtual analog polysynth Rack Extension (in development, latest build `0.9.6f4`, 2026-11-25 / source `0.9.6f5`, 2026-11-28) with a seven-saw super wave, hard sync, ring and cross modulation, multimode filter, Unison, arpeggiator, 13 effects, a 12-in / 4-out CV bay, and 160 patches.
- [Reboot — Sound Chip Synth](https://protocodus.cz/product/reboot/): 8-bit sound chip synth Rack Extension (in development, latest build `0.10.0f1`, 2026-11-27 / source `0.10.0f2`, 2026-11-28) emulating the Handheld and Console chip by chip via frame register writes, with cartridges A–E, up to 8 boards, and Double.
- [YouKnow — Circuit-Modelled Synth](https://protocodus.cz/product/youknow/): Circuit-modelled 1984 polysynth Rack Extension (Shop release `1.4.11`, device `1.4.11f4`, first released 2026-10-05; latest build `1.4.11f5`, 2026-11-21; native C++ core `1.4.11`) with 1–16 voices, nonlinear VCF, stereo BBD chorus, and 8 CV inputs. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/youknow-circuit-modelled-synth/)
- [Ceres — Circuit-Modelled Synth](https://protocodus.cz/product/ceres/): Dual-layer circuit-modelled polysynth Rack Extension (Shop release `1.1.4`, 2026-11-02; latest build `1.1.8f5`, 2026-11-17) with 1–16 voices per layer, HP/LP filters, sub-oscillator, ring modulation, and 23 patches. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/ceres-circuit-modelled-synth/)
- [Press78 — FM Synthesizer](https://protocodus.cz/product/press78/): Twelve-voice two-operator FM synthesizer Rack Extension (Shop release `1.0.4`, 2026-11-02; latest build `1.0.6f4`, 2026-11-17) with editable envelopes, stereo chorus, modelled output circuit, and 150 presets. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/press78-fm-synth/)

## Effects & Utilities (Newest First)

- [Reform — Sound Morpher](https://protocodus.cz/product/reform/): Two-input sound morpher Rack Extension (in development, source `0.1.0d3`, 2026-11-28) that turns input A into input B, with Mix as the master and five Follow knobs for timbre, pitch, amplitude, attack, and noise.
- [Churech — Church Reverb](https://protocodus.cz/product/churech/): Cruciform stone church reverb Rack Extension (in development, latest build `0.15.2d6`, 2026-11-28) built from Oregana's church, with four spaces from chapel to cathedral, Organ Loft placement, Freeze, external sidechain ducking, sixteen CV inputs, and 64 patches.
- [Unrest — Resonance Suppressor](https://protocodus.cz/product/unrest/): Dynamic spectral resonance suppressor Rack Extension (in development, latest build `1.0.0f3`, 2026-11-24) with 32-band self-tuning parametric EQ (Normal/Ahead) and Linear mode, Stereo Balance L/M to R/S, external sidechain, Delta listen, Iron/Tube/Opto stages, and 65 patches.
- [Retra — Retro Processor](https://protocodus.cz/product/retra/): Stereo retro processor Rack Extension (in development, latest build `0.8.0f5`, 2026-11-26) with eight slots, each choosing one of eight stages (distortion, tape/vinyl, wobble, dropouts, reactive noise, amplifier, speaker, codecs) with 25 patches.
- [Remit — Digital Reverberator](https://protocodus.cz/product/remit/): Digital reverb Rack Extension (Shop release `0.4.0`, 2026-11-20; latest build `0.5.2f1`, 2026-11-27) modelling five 1976–1986 hardware converters and delay tanks, four programs, quad rear outputs, and 20 patches. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/remit-digital-reverberator/)
- [Binaurel — 3D Headphone Panner](https://protocodus.cz/product/binaurel/): 3D binaural headphone panner Rack Extension (Shop release `0.1.0`, 2026-11-04; latest build `0.1.0f4`, 2026-11-18) with azimuth, elevation, distance, room reflections, and six CV inputs. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/binaurel-advanced-panner/)
- [Remix — Crossfader Utility](https://protocodus.cz/product/remix/): Free 3U crossfader utility Rack Extension (in development, latest build `1.2.0f4`, 2026-11-17) with Shape, Skew, and Sigmoid curve controls, three mix modes, live scope, and CV position control.
- [Convretor — Audio to CV Utility](https://protocodus.cz/product/convretor/): 5U audio-to-CV utility Rack Extension (in development, latest build `0.2.0f7`, 2026-11-27) with input gain, 6/12/24 dB HP/LP filters, an envelope follower, four scaled, invertible CV outputs, and a threshold gate output.
- [Lamer Degrader — Creative Codec Effect](https://protocodus.cz/product/lamer/): Real-time MP3 and Ogg Vorbis codec degrader Rack Extension (Shop release `1.0.0`, 2026-10-21; latest build `1.0.1f3`, 2026-11-17) with 8–256 kbps targets, 1–4 cascaded passes, and dry/wet mix. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/lamer-degrader/)

## Command-Line Tools

- [Podcare](https://protocodus.cz/#products): Python command-line podcast production tool that cleans, aligns, and levels multi-microphone recordings with noise reduction, filler-word removal, and loudness mastering.

## Browser Games and Musical Instruments

- [Protocodus Fun](https://protocodus.cz/fun/): Play the Oregana church organ, Keyra piano and eight browser games without installation or an account.
- [Play Keyra](https://protocodus.cz/fun/keyra/): Play five modelled acoustic pianos with mouse, touch, computer keyboard or MIDI.
- [Play Oregana](https://protocodus.cz/fun/oregana/): A modelled 51-stop church organ for mouse, computer keyboard or MIDI keyboard.
- [Tyran](https://protocodus.cz/fun/tyran/): Arcade vertical space shooter across ten sectors with squadron formations, boss guardians, wing drones, and ship upgrades.
- [Ashline](https://protocodus.cz/fun/ashline/): Sci-fi real-time strategy game with a ten-operation campaign and skirmish modes featuring Organics and AI Unity factions, base building, power logistics, and unit promotions.
- [Alpen](https://protocodus.cz/fun/alpen/): Endless 3D alpine snowboarding game with changing weather, carving, grabs, flips, and score combos.
- [Meteora](https://protocodus.cz/fun/meteora/): Story-driven 3D space combat game with ten campaign missions, tactical briefings, ship loadouts, and survival mode in the Meteora asteroid belt.
- [Bridger](https://protocodus.cz/fun/bridger/): 2D bridge-building physics game for kids and adults: build from road, wood, steel and cable, test with a car, truck or train, and watch live stress colours. Every generated river is proven solvable within its budget.
- [Fortress](https://protocodus.cz/fun/fortress/): A 2D catapult physics game. Choose a small, medium or large randomly generated hill fort in one of five realms. Use stones, bombs and fireballs to undermine or burn its towers and defeat its orc defenders for the lowest ammunition cost.
- [Puzzle Box](https://protocodus.cz/fun/puzzles/): Two 3D logic puzzle games for kids and adults — Zipper (single-line pathing) and Patcher (board region cutting) — with daily puzzles and three difficulty sizes.
